note: The campground and day-use zone of Willow Creek Provincial Park passed to the Municipal District of Willow Creek in 2010, and Stavely Elks Parks runs it; 16 km west of Stavely on Hwy 527. Sites lie on both sides of Willow Creek, joined by a bridge, with a creek swimming area and beach, camp kitchens and a playground. Quads, ATVs and other off-road vehicles are not allowed; generators 9 am-1 pm and 5-9 pm. --Claude
